en: Each account in Automatic handoff preferences now has a pause/resume button. Paused accounts are skipped during automatic quota handoff for this task only; their order and model settings are preserved.
Pause settings survive reopening the task and apply during an active run. Pausing does not interrupt the current execution or prevent manual account selection.
zh: “自动接续偏好”中的每个账号新增暂停、恢复按钮；自动轮换会跳过暂停的账号，仅影响当前任务，并保留原有排序和模型设置。
暂停设置会保存，重新打开任务仍然有效，运行中也可设置；暂停不会中断正在执行的账号，也不限制手动选择账号。
